bash: mkdir -p /tmp/acltest && cd /tmp/acltest && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, struct
p='/tmp/acltest'
# minimal ACL: version 2, entries: user_obj rwx, group_obj rwx, other ---, mask rwx
acl = struct.pack('<I',2)
for tag,perm in ((0x01,7),(0x04,7),(0x20,7),(0x10,0)):
    acl += struct.pack('<HHI',tag,perm,0xffffffff)
try:
    os.setxattr(p,'system.posix_acl_access',acl)
    print("SETXATTR OK")
    print("READBACK:", os.getxattr(p,'system.posix_acl_access'))
except OSError as e:
    print("SETXATTR FAILED:", e)
EOF
ls -ld /tmp/acltest; rm -rf /tmp/acltest
